patthana15.79:1.1: Saraṇaṃ ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo naācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā dve.
patthana15.79:2.1: Araṇaṃ apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo naapacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana15.79:3.1: Araṇaṃ nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā naaraṇo nanevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
